name: bq-corporate-tax
description: Analyse 2026 entity taxation in Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba. Use for corporate residence decisions, distribution tax, holding companies, substance tests, participation exemptions, gross-ups and minimum-tax screening. Distinguishes BES status from European Netherlands corporate and dividend taxation, distributions from accounting profit, and ordinary returns from minimum-tax obligations. Includes primary legislation, current authority guidance, conditional examples and reconciliation controls. Records outdated guidance, separate retention duties and unresolved foundation withholding. This source-cited draft holds foreign relief, special entities, exit valuations, minimum-tax computations and unmapped returns. Load with the corporate income tax workflow base; professional review remains required.
